description:
Cast Deep Forest Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deep Forest Hermit and a Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Deep Forest Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
